findings.title: LALIGA ha sido víctima de un ciberataque que ha afectado a datos personales de aficionados
findings.summary_md: LaLiga's press release says a cybercriminal accessed one of its fan-services technology platforms between 14 and 16 November 2026 and extracted personal data from users registered with LaLiga and some clubs. The league says its security teams identified the access source, contained the attack on 16 November, stopped the extraction and blocked the attacker, with no effect on other LaLiga systems or competition operations. It reported the incident to the Spanish Data Protection Agency and filed a complaint with the National Police Central Cybercrime Unit, and says affected clubs were informed.

findings.title: LaLiga sufre un ciberataque con acceso a datos personales de aficionados
findings.summary_md: Marca reported that LaLiga had disclosed unauthorized access to personal data of users registered in digital services run by the league and some clubs. The article places the intrusion between 14 and 16 November and says security teams detected the access source and contained it on 16 November, stopping further extraction and blocking the attacker. It adds that LaLiga opened an internal investigation into scope and user count, notified the AEPD, filed a complaint with the National Police Cybercrime Unit, and was coordinating with affected clubs.
